item.tib: bka' gsang mkha' 'gro'i snyan rgyud gu ru'i thugs bcud las mkha' 'gro seng gdong khros ma'i zlog pa mtshon cha'i 'khor lo
item.coloph: mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i zlog pa 'di/ ma 'ongs 'gro ba rnams kyi don ched du/ mkha' 'gro ma'i (mas) dus mtha'i kho bo bdag la brgyud/ (byang chub rdo rje rtsal) =mchan dam nyams ru tra can la gsang*/ rgya rgya rgya/ i thi/ rjes 'jug bon gshen rnams kyis bskul ba'i ngor/ mdzod nag bkra shis lhun khrod du bkod pa dge legs 'phel//
